title: 4x Vanilla World Gen
description: The Large Biomes experience without the Large Biomes world type.
body:
# 4x Vanilla World Gen

Matches Minecraft's built-in Large Biomes preset exactly, but works on a normal world. Biomes four times wider than vanilla. The game still feels like the game.

## Features
- All 5 climate parameters scaled: temperature, vegetation, continentalness, erosion, and weirdness
- Biomes 4x wider than vanilla, equivalent to Large Biomes
- Normal world type (no presets required)
- Part of the Vanilla World Gen series: 2x · 4x · 8x · 16x · 32x · 64x

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Create a new world (Normal type)
3. Load in. Only affects ungenerated chunks.

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack, no mods, no executables
